svg.title: How agent-mesh works
svg.desc: A zen rock garden. Each person's machine is a stone; raked ripples spread from every stone and merge directly where they meet — messages travel peer to peer with nothing in between. The raked bed itself is the hive, the shared memory every agent tends.
